description: This Java class defines a reactive stream flow for updating search index data in MongoDB using Akka Streams. It manages batching, parallelism, timing, and error handling for bulk write operations.

classes.name: MongoSearchUpdaterFlow
classes.description: A final class that manages a reactive stream flow for updating search index data in MongoDB, including batching, timing, and error handling.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of MongoSearchUpdaterFlow from a MongoDatabase.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Creates a reactive flow for processing source streams of write models, batching, timing, and executing bulk writes to MongoDB.

methods.name: executeBulkWrite
methods.description: Performs bulk write operations to MongoDB, handling success and exceptions, returning a source of write results and errors.

methods.name: createStartTimerFlow
methods.description: Creates a flow that starts a timer and records metrics for each batch of write models.

methods.name: createStopTimerFlow
methods.description: Creates a flow that stops the timer started by createStartTimerFlow, handling potential illegal state exceptions.

methods.name: assembleFlows
methods.description: Builds a composite Akka Streams graph combining multiple processing stages, including batching, timing, and result processing.
